factory_install: Check default action everytime shim reloads. Previously factory shim only checks the default action once. When the default action returns to shim menu (maybe it failed), it will not do the default action again. This causes inconsistency shim behavior and confuses users, so we make it check the default action everytime. Also display cr50 version in the device info header for easier debugging. kukui: Pulse PMIC_FORCE_RESET_ODL on external reset If the reset cause is external, it is wise to reset the PMIC registers, which can be achieved by pulsing the force reset signal to PMIC. We found in previous experiments that 5ms is often enough to reset the PMIC, but that occasionally the PMIC would auto-restart if the pulse is so short (so we pulse for 10s when we force shutdown the AP). Here, we pulse for 100ms, which is an acceptable delay in these situations, and hopefully long enough to recover from bad PMIC settings. BRANCH=none BUG=b:123154929 TEST=Boot kukui, external reset cause the PMIC to power cycle, measured using PMIC_EC_RESETB. TEST=AP normal reboot does not cause such a reset. TEST=See that most PMIC registers are reset after force reset is used (see bug). Change-Id: Iddbc20506890b3f904c36642515a0502d90462a3 Signed-off-by: Nicolas Boichat <drinkcat@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1490799 Reviewed-by: Yilun Lin <yllin@chromium.org>
